shortDescription: Authenticate and get a session token

options.name: api_port
options.description: Port for the Technitium DNS API. Defaults to 5380

options.name: api_url
options.description: Base URL for the Technitium DNS API

options.name: include_info
options.description: Include basic user info and permissions in the response.

options.name: password
options.description: The password for the user account. The default password for admin user is 'admin'.

options.name: totp
options.description: The time-based one-time password if 2FA is enabled for the user account.

options.name: username
options.description: The username for the user account. The built-in administrator username is 'admin'.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when making API requests.
